verdict.rationale: The only pricing evidence is a generic plan listing (Solo Plan $10/month) with no unit economics tied to data sources, connectors, or compute usage that would let a platform lead estimate the cost impact of connecting a new source before doing so. Missing for 10: any documented cost driver (e.g., per-asset, per-run, or per-source pricing), usage calculator, or worked example showing how adding a new connector/source changes the bill.
